name: Deficit Diamond Push-Up
description: A diamond push-up performed with hands elevated on plates or blocks to allow greater depth of chest descent. The deficit increases the range of motion and time under tension for the triceps and chest. This advanced variation builds significant tricep mass.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Deficit Diamond Push-Up in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Deficit Diamond Push-Up.
steps: Step 1: Place hands on two equal-height elevations with thumbs and forefingers touching in diamond shape.
Step 2: Assume push-up position with body rigid.
Step 3: Lower chest below hand level taking advantage of deficit.
Step 4: Press back up through triceps and chest to full extension.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Thumbs and index fingers form a diamond
Lower chest as far as range allows
